title: mentha ensidens
intro: Mentha ensidens, commonly known as the Japanese mint, is a species of plant in the mint family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha ensidens include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful for treating conditions such as headaches and nausea. The bioactive constituents of Mentha ensidens include menthone, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
